title: The Little Queen and the Lantern Star

scenes.prompt: The Little Queen stands upright in a warm royal library, holding her vertical Moonstar wand at waist height beside her body, while a tiny fallen star glows on an open book.
scenes.script: One quiet evening, the Little Queen found a tiny fallen star glowing between the pages of an old library book.

scenes.prompt: The Little Queen stands on a broad autumn garden path at dusk, holding her vertical Moonstar wand at waist height beside her body, with the little star floating safely near her shoulder.
scenes.script: She carried the star through the autumn garden, following its soft golden light toward the highest castle tower.

scenes.prompt: The Little Queen stands upright on a castle observatory terrace beneath a clear night sky, holding her vertical Moonstar wand at waist height as the little star rises toward its constellation.
scenes.script: At the observatory, the Little Queen raised the star home, and the whole sky sparkled to thank her.
